description: github-backup configuration: owners, tier rules, exclusions. Adding an owner/org is an edit to this file plus the commands in docs/RUNBOOK.md — never a code change.

owner_notes.vertexinc: GAP: org enforces SAML SSO; the token cannot enumerate it. Nothing under it is mirrored.
owner_notes.NixOS: Member-only org: mirrored by the sweep (readable), but the backup GitHub App cannot be installed here — no webhook coverage.
owner_notes.dezren39/edsebooks: GAP: GitHub returns HTTP 451 (repository access blocked). Cannot be fetched.

force_include_reasons.dezren39/opencode: 502 MB but the live chain parent of developing-today/opencode.
force_include_reasons.dezren39/Quake_4_Alpha: 1.35 GB, Drew's own recent work (not a passive mirror).

tier_rules.families: Forks sharing an upstream (parent) with >=2 included copies, or whose parent is itself included, are cloned with git alternates against the family anchor (first/full mirror of that history). Anchors are recorded in FAMILIES.md in the backup tree.
